Subject: Rider Alert 11/4 Golden Gate Ferry Larkspur
TextBody:
Due to a mechanical issue, some trips will be delayed/disrupted today. See below and stay tuned for updates. 

*Larkspur - San Francisco
*7:15am now a 55 minute trip. Arrival delayed to 8:10am.

*San Francisco - Larkspur
*8:00am departure delayed up to 15 minutes. Also a 55 minute trip.

Thank you for your patience.

________________________________________________________________________


For trip-planning assistance, call 511/415-455-2000 /TDD 711. Customer service representatives are available weekdays from 7:00 am to 6:00 pm.
